title: Acanthamoeba ATP synthase structure reveals the TCA cycle is tethered to OXPHOS.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Queried the RCSB PDB (Protein Data Bank) API for 9ZFT (ATP synthase monomer) and 9ZFX (malate dehydrogenase crystal structure): both returned 404, so they are not yet released. Grepped the full text for accessions: found PDB 9ZFR-9ZFX and EMDB (Electron Microscopy Data Bank) maps EMD-74149 to EMD-74156; no PRIDE/MassIVE proteomics accession found. Europe PMC supplement listing timed out.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That the deposits are 7 structures (Hsp60, complex III, ATP synthase parts, MDH crystal structure) plus 8 cryo-EM maps; supplementary Data S1-S4 are a consortium roster, subunit sequences and phylogenies.

a1_downloadable.note: PDB entries 9ZFT and 9ZFX return 404 from RCSB (unreleased); supplement not retrievable. Even once released, these are a handful of structure files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No label table exists; the output is a few 3D atomic models and density maps of one organism's complexes, not a set of labelled examples.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be subunit sequences (Data S2, per paper text only), not checked.

a4_units_stated.note: No measured quantity table to carry units.

a5_enough_rows.note: About 7 structures and 8 maps per the paper text; far below 400 examples.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown, likely <5 GB for models; maps larger

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not check; entries not released.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper yields a few single-organism structures, not a labelled dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein subunit sequences to predict which lineage-specific subunits attach to the mitochondrial ATP-making machine.
plain_idea.train_on: Subunit sequences of Acanthamoeba ATP synthase and partners; number of examples unknown, likely a few dozen.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a protein is a structural member of the complex, taken from the cryo-EM (frozen-sample electron microscopy) models.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would help annotate odd energy-machine subunits in poorly studied protists, but this paper alone is far too small to train on.

ml_idea: None viable; structural biology paper with ~7 unreleased PDB entries and no tabular labels.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: RCSB lookup of 9ZFT returned 404 (unreleased), and the deposit is only ~7 structures.

verdict_reason: Single-organism cryo-EM structure paper: about 7 PDB entries (unreleased, 404 on RCSB) and 8 maps, with no labelled table, so A1, A2 and A5 fail.
